title: check-driver-conformance: the docblock ratios justifying its declared hint are stale and undated
body:
`scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` argues, in the docblock over its
`ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` declaration, why the hint is the drivers subtree and not the
top-level root, and it argues it with measured ratios:

> packages slash star-star            259 files this gate reads, of 4903 tracked — 5.3%
> packages/drivers subtree            259 of 291 — 89%
> The remaining 32 files under the drivers root are the per-package manifests, licences and changelogs

Re-measured today at `2200f8ec` (tree `b8ebad25`) by driving the gate itself under an
fs recorder rather than reproducing its filter by hand:

| term | docblock | measured today |
|:--|--:|--:|
| files the walk opens under the drivers subtree | 259 | 344 |
| tracked files under that subtree | 291 | 379 |
| tracked files under the top-level root | 4903 | 5979 |
| ratio at the subtree | 89% | 90.8% |
| ratio at the top-level root | 5.3% | 5.8% |

The residue is 30 files the gate neither opens nor stats (five per-package manifests
are statted as the existence test that admits a package to the matrix), and its
composition is wider than the three kinds the docblock names: 11 markdown, 6 tsconfig
JSON, 6 config `.ts` sitting beside the manifests rather than under a src directory,
5 LICENSE, one `.mjs` and one dotfile.

**Nothing reds on this and the argument's conclusion is unchanged** — the subtree
declaration is still the right one, by a slightly wider margin than recorded. What is
wrong is that the digits carry no date, so a reader takes them as current. The
bare-root worklist row that judges this same declaration now carries the pair
re-measured on one tree, with the date and the base commit in it, so the two readings
now disagree in print.

Shape of the repair: re-measure both terms together on one tree and date them, or drop
the digits and keep the shape of the argument. ⛔ Both terms together — the worklist's
own docblock forbids refreshing a denominator apart from its numerator.

Found while implementing #15270, whose file surface was the worklist alone and whose
dispatch ruled out any edit to this gate by name. Filed unassigned.
